status: frozen before C03 fits or outcome scoring
population: exact known B1 200 game IDs; first20 selection rollouts; actual participants and stored simulated rotations; no operational claim
inputs: C02 causal-first/prior-position profile and team profile; CONTEXT except season, core LINEUP, elapsed duration; five PROFILE/IN_GAME/grp_code/usage_share/usage_rank/usage_mult_now. All families same arrays and history. No IDs/targets/foul_event in joint inputs.
opponent_audit: Only dated team_d_{pace,three,rim,tov,foul,oreb} and causal core defensive lineup aggregates. Source features_report history_only, causal_first_priors, causal_positions required. No body/matchup/implicit defender responsibility. No additional opponent bundle admitted.
choice: 43 fixed alternatives: slot0..4 x WHAT0..7, then defensive foul, violation/jump ball, team turnover. Event marginal; actor conditional on action; action conditional on actor. Defensive foul FT actor remains unchanged incumbent resolver in every arm.
support: event dataset legal reconstructed fives; actions must be nonheave, known zone/label, actor in offensive five. Actorless events retained regardless actor metadata. Exclusions fixed without probabilities; same keys all models. Full-game truth unchanged.

history.sampling: smallest uint64 pandas hash of seg_id with hash_key=0123456789123456 per block, then chronological order; outcome blind
history.weights: uniform common event weights; no date tuning
history.phase: context before elapsed clock; player sec_so_far after elapsed; all other counters before event

A.features: same common columns per relevant head, training-only mean/std, missing indicators, clip standardised inputs to +/-8; bias. Separate 4-event, grouped5-actor, 8-action heads. Training effective-sample shrinkage implicit in L2 and missing indicators. Select epoch on training-only chronological selection block; refit train+selection at chosen epoch.

B.selection: best chronological validation iteration, patience15; refit train+selection

C.selection: best chronological validation iteration, patience10; refit train+selection
C.objective: single scalar scorer common learned trees over all 43 alternatives; exact group43 softmax loss; diagonal Hessian 2p(1-p). Common context, candidate player features (missing for actorless), choice_type0..10. Shared learned splits/parameters across event/player/action. No truth-dependent masks.

budget.data_passes: four yearly training builds plus one panel; no new provider
budget.fits: one selection and one refit per head (A3/B3/C1), then exactly one independent repeat; no extra recipes
budget.rollouts: every mechanically valid MVP first20 x1000 worlds plus shared compatible C02 incumbent control; only shortlisted finalists remaining180; one fresh full1000 replay per family; no extra precision
budget.threads: <=10 total heavy; fits10 then rollouts10x1; BLAS/Arrow1
budget.technical_reruns: only documented faults; preserve partial artifacts and original receipts; no score-driven change

shortlist.primary: player PTS CRPS relative change <= -0.005 on20, both500-world halves <0; point estimates only for promise, not significance
shortlist.event: finite common NLL/Brier; no next-event improvement prerequisite
shortlist.runtime: candidate/control saved per-game generation median ratio <=8; total fixed cap; source/mechanical failures fail closed
shortlist.ranking: eligible ordered playerPTS CRPS gain, retain best2; uncertainty overlap does not force single winner

finalist_acceptance: 200 known games only: primary playerPTS >=1% gain and game/week familywise upper<0 across3 initial comparisons; both simulation halves improve; same harm margins require familywise upper below margin; >=100games overall, critical contexts >=30games/200player rows. No independent confirmation or release claim.

uncertainty.units: whole games and fixed ordinal//7 calendar blocks; pooled and equal-game
uncertainty.intervals: descriptive95 plus Bonferroni familywise 98.33333333333333% across initial3 for all decisions; no exposure reset; harms and support conjunctive

stopping: No qualifying20game candidate => bounded negative search, no remaining180. No posthoc alternatives. Independent fresh fits/probabilities and one replay per valid family; independent saved-array score/accounting check.
